name: harness
description: Runs the real game headless: the files of `/Users/macbookair/game/src/manifest.json` are loaded in order into one Node `vm` context with stub browser globals (`document.createElement('canvas')` and the 480×270 `#game` canvas are `@napi-rs/canvas` canvases; no audio, no speech, in-memory `localStorage`, `requestAnimationFrame` does nothing). The harness then calls the game's own `update()` / `draw()`. Node 22; `@napi-rs/canvas` is installed in this folder.
